text:
Tampa Bay arrives on the second night of a back-to-back after an 8-3 win in Buffalo, where Nikita Kucherov scored three goals and John Carlson reached 800 career points. The Lightning are 4-1-0 in their last five, without Brayden Point (16 points in 17 games) and Erik Cernak. Brandon Hagel has taken Point's spot beside Jake Guentzel and Kucherov, and Sam O'Reilly has moved onto the first power-play unit. Columbus is 2-3-0 over the same stretch, fresh off a 4-1 home loss to Florida.

Our numbers favor the visitors. At five on five, TBL has taken 55% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) in its games, CBJ 49%. Special teams are close: TBL creates 0.78 expected goals per game on the power play, CBJ 0.56. In net, projected starters Dennis Hildeby (TBL) and Jet Greaves (CBJ) are both below expected this season, at -1.2 and -1.8 goals saved above expected, though both finished well above last year.

Guentzel, playing his 700th NHL game, is at 38% to score, with Kucherov also at 38% and Hagel at 40%. For Columbus, Kent Johnson is at 23%, and Mathieu Olivier sits one goal from 50 for his career. Our under-the-radar pick is Conor Geekie, who plays fourth-line minutes for TBL but has 2.0 expected goals in his last 10 games. We have him at 12% to score, a player to watch, not a lock.
